reason: This is the only available combination and follows the dust into the galaxy's hot outer gas.

reaction: The contrast between earlier warming and later grain destruction was interesting.

mostWorthwhile.text: Forming young stars from the surviving clumps was satisfying because it carried the old pillars' story forward.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final dust action was the only available choice, so it felt more like inevitable progress than a decision.

surprise.text: I was struck by the distinction between dust reradiating absorbed starlight in infrared and its later erosion in hot gas.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the dust's outward journey and encounter with hot gas had clear purposes.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow how the remaining material changes, especially after seeing the clumps form new stars and the dust take different paths.
